# Template placeholders — MUST NOT block.

# Bracket templates
<YOUR_API_KEY>
<YOUR_AWS_KEY>
<INSERT_HERE>
<your-secret>
<API_KEY>
<TOKEN>

# Interpolation syntax
${API_KEY}
${AWS_SECRET}
{{api_key}}
{{user_token}}

# "your-X-here" / marker phrases
your-secret-key-here
YOUR_API_KEY_HERE
insert-your-token-here
REPLACE_ME_BEFORE_DEPLOY
example-aws-key-here
sample_aws_secret
PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN
